items.headline: $ZKL Bridge Exploit Drains $779K in One Transaction
items.summary: zkLink Nova's bridge was hit via a forged batch root, enabling unauthorized withdrawals of about $779,000. Blockaid warned the main Ethereum escrow still showed an unpaused status.

items.headline: $DIVA Cancels Mainnet, Tells Early Stakers to Withdraw
items.summary: Diva abruptly scrapped its mainnet launch with ~654.5 ETH sitting in two pre-launch vaults. The shutdown statement offers no replacement $DIVA distribution, leaving early backers empty-handed.

items.headline: $FLR's FXRP Pool on Morpho Nearly Full on Loan Demand
items.summary: Demand for XRP-backed loans has nearly filled Flare's FXRP pool on Morpho, signaling surging DeFi utility on the $FLR network.

items.headline: Tokenized $GOOGL Drops 12% in After-Hours Selloff
items.summary: A Uniswap pool handled ~$603,000 in five minutes as Alphabet-linked tokenized shares repriced sharply lower after the close. Onchain stock tokens are showing real-time price discovery.

items.headline: $BTC Core Patches Three Bugs Including Node Crash
items.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes across four release branches, including a non-Linux node crash bug. 32-bit systems and FAT32 storage remain exposed to a separate low-severity flaw.
